jobAdDetails.description:

jobAdDetails.title: Audience Acquisition/Delegate Sales - Fintech Meetup
jobAdDetails.description:
Division: Fintech Meetup
Reports to: EJ Quinn, Community
Location: New York, USA (Hybrid)

A bit about us

We’re Hyve – organizer of the world’s fastest-growing and most forward-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies – helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth, and connect with the people who matter most.

Our portfolio features some of the world's leading events across fintech, healthcare, education, retail, and ecommerce. We're growing fast through a combination of organic innovation and an ambitious acquisition strategy, bringing exciting new communities and products into our portfolio.

Fintech Meetup is redefining what a fintech event can be. Through market-leading content, the industry’s leading meetings programme, and an expanding portfolio of networking experiences, we're creating the most valuable place for the global fintech ecosystem to meet, build relationships, and grow their business.

This is an exciting moment to join. Since the event joined Hyve, we've invested heavily in building an exceptional team, strengthening our products, and accelerating growth. With those foundations now firmly in place, we're looking for an outstanding commercial leader to help shape the next chapter.

Think that sounds good? Wait until our talent acquisition team tells you about the culture.

A bit about you

First things first: whatever your background, beliefs, or ambitions, there's a culture of belonging at Hyve, and everyone is welcome. The question isn't where you've come from, but where you want to go.

We're looking for someone who is ambitious, collaborative, and commercially minded, with the drive to deliver outstanding results. You'll be proactive, adaptable, and confident taking ownership, with a willingness to get stuck in and make things happen. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, embrace change, and are always looking for opportunities to learn, improve, and create impact.

Most importantly, you're a team player who takes pride in your work and understands that delivering exceptional events sometimes means rolling up your sleeves and supporting colleagues during the busiest periods of the event cycle.

If you're motivated by challenges, excited by growth, and eager to contribute to a high-performing team, you'll fit right in.

A bit about the role

This role reports to the Community Director – Fintech USA.

Fintech Meetup is the premier meeting place for banks, credit unions, startups, investors, and retailers.

We are seeking an experienced, commercially driven Delegate Sales Manager to lead delegate acquisition, grow delegate revenue, and drive attendance growth across key audience segments.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal sales, marketing, and community teams to develop and execute delegate sales campaigns, manage audience acquisition plans, and maximize delegate revenue.

This is your opportunity to help shape the future of an industry-leading event. A results-oriented event delegate sales professional with a proven track record in conference delegate sales and audience development will thrive in this role.

The excitement doesn't stop at Fintech Meetup USA. You'll roll straight into the next events in the portfolio, playing a key role in delivering world-class experiences throughout the entire year.

As part of your job, you’ll be:

Delegate Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and implement delegate acquisition strategies to achieve attendance and revenue targets for FTMU USA.
  • Identify, prioritize, and penetrate key audience segments, including mining companies, government representatives, financial institutions, EPCs, technology providers, and industry associations.
  • Build and manage delegate sales pipelines to ensure consistent delivery against targets.
  • Monitor sales performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and campaign effectiveness.

Campaign Planning & Execution

  • Work closely with the Marketing and Community teams to develop targeted acquisition campaigns across email, digital, content marketing, partnerships, and telemarketing channels.
  • Provide audience insights and sales intelligence to support campaign development and optimization.
  • Track campaign performance and recommend adjustments to maximize ROI and delegate registrations.
  • Keep up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics to position our event competitively.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sponsorship and Exhibition Sales, and Community teams to deliver a cohesive delegate acquisition strategy.
  • Develop relationships with industry associations, partners, and key stakeholders to support audience growth.
  • Identify and secure strategic partnerships that drive delegate registrations.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and reporting through internal systems.
  • Analyze delegate acquisition metrics, sales activity, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
  • Present regular updates and recommendations to senior management.
  • Use data-driven insights to continuously improve acquisition strategies.

Here’s what we’re looking for from you:

  • 3–5+ years’ experience in conference delegate sales, event audience acquisition, or B2B event sales.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding delegate revenue and attendance targets.
  • Experience managing telesales teams, outsourced agencies, or high-volume sales operations.
  • Strong understanding of sales funnels, lead management, and CRM systems.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Highly analytical, with the ability to interpret sales and marketing performance data.
  • Strong commercial mindset with a focus on revenue growth and customer acquisition.
  • Experience working closely with marketing teams to develop integrated campaigns.

The benefits

  • Salary range of $85,000–$95,000, based on experience.
  • Competitive bonus structure.
  • Full medical, dental, and vision package to fit your needs.
  • Retirement plan with company match (401K).
  • Competitive vacation policy.
  • Hybrid working.

Ready to make some great experiences? Your Hyve adventure begins with one click – apply now!

jobAdDetails.title: Head of Product Delivery - London Market
jobAdDetails.description:
Function: Product Management & Delivery 
Reports to: Chief Operating Officer 
Direct reports: Client Product Owner team 
Location: United Kingdom 

Company summary 
Buckhill is a global technology company with offices in the UK and Croatia. As a strategic technology partner to the London Market, we deliver modern insurance solutions through agile, cross-functional delivery teams leveraging AI capabilities, a growing partner ecosystem, and a culture rooted in innovation and collaboration. We support continuous learning and invest in the growth of our Bucks, fostering an environment where people thrive. With the option for remote work, we have expanded our global footprint, building a diverse and multicultural team making a real impact.

Role summary 
You already know how the London Market really works. This is a role where you get to shape the systems it runs on.
 
As Head of Product Delivery at Buckhill, you will lead our Client Product Owner team and own how our products serve the Lloyd’s and wider London Market.

This role is deliberately built for someone who knows the market from the inside. If you have spent your career in underwriting operations, market operations or a comparable function within a managing agent, syndicate, broker, MGA or market service provider, you will recognise most of what our products are trying to solve: manual workflows, fragmented data, and processes that work because experienced people work around them. We want that operational knowledge at the centre of our product function rather than at the edge of it.

You do not need a long formal product management career behind you. You do need a working understanding of how product teams operate, genuine interest in doing that work well, and the appetite to build your knowledge of C2MS to complement your London Market knowledge. Market knowledge is the harder thing to teach quickly, which is why we are hiring for it directly.

The market’s modernisation agenda has also changed shape. The ambition to replace everything at once has given way to incremental modernisation, longer parallel running between old and new systems, and a sharper focus on operational resilience and data standards. Meanwhile the underlying problems have not gone anywhere: manual workflows, fragmented data, and legacy processes that hold the market back. That is the environment our products operate in, and it is why we want someone who has lived it leading our product delivery function rather than advising it from the sidelines.

In this role you will define and own the product delivery vision for C2MS, lead and develop our Client Product Owner team, and act as the senior product voice in front of our clients. Buckhill is on an exciting trajectory, transitioning from a bespoke InsurTech software development company towards a more product-focused organisation, and this role is central to that shift.

This role sits within the Product Management & Delivery function and reports to Buckhill’s Chief Operating Officer. You will hold line management responsibility for Buckhill’s Client Product Owner team, and you will work as part of a cross-functional structure designed to drive consistent product excellence across our portfolio.

This role is based in the United Kingdom. The successful candidate must be located in the UK and have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have spent years knowing exactly why a process is broken and never being the person who could change it, this is the role where you can.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
Essential
  • Substantial experience within the Lloyd’s of London or wider London Market, gained in underwriting operations, market operations, delivery, change or a comparable function within a managing agent, broker, MGA or market service provider.
  • Detailed working knowledge of London Market processes, including placement, policy administration, premium processing, delegated authority and coverholder operations, claims, and the regulatory environment specific to Lloyd’s.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery and the Product Owner role, whether gained as a practitioner, as a senior business stakeholder to a product or change team, or through formal training.
  • Demonstrable experience of leading, managing or developing others, whether through formal line management or leading a team through a significant change programme.
  • A track record of translating operational problems into system or process improvements, rather than working around them.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the credibility to hold a senior client conversation on market matters.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in data-driven decision making, and strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with AI tools and a proactive attitude towards embedding them into working practice.
  • Located in the UK with the right to work in the UK, and willing to travel occasionally to meet clients and stakeholders.
Desirable
  • Prior experience in a formal Product Owner or Product Manager role.
  • Product certifications such as PSPO or equivalent.
  • CII qualifications, particularly LM1 or LM2, or progress towards them.
  • Experience of insurance technology implementation, data migration or vendor-side delivery.
  • Broader InsurTech or FinTech background.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or a relevant postgraduate qualification.
How we will support you
We are recruiting deliberately for London Market expertise, and we recognise that the strongest market candidates may not have spent their careers in formal product roles. We will invest in closing that gap.
  • A structured product craft development plan agreed within your first month, with formal training and external coaching where useful.
  • Funded CII pathway support, including LM1 and LM2 where relevant.
  • Access to experienced product and delivery colleagues who know our products in depth, alongside dedicated time for your own development rather than development squeezed around delivery.
  • A defined review cadence in your first twelve months so that progress, support and expectations remain explicit on both sides.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Product accountabilities
  • Define and communicate Buckhill’s C2MS product vision, strategy and goals aligned with our business objectives. Develop and maintain a clear, prioritised product roadmap based on market research, client feedback and business priorities.
  • Gather and translate requirements from internal and external stakeholders, including underwriters, brokers and operations teams within the Lloyd’s and London Market, and ensure their needs are addressed within the product.
  • Own the overall product backlog across the team, ensuring well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria are consistently applied.
  • Work closely with Client Product Owners, Delivery Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, Designers, Solutions Engineers, Customer Support and QA teams to deliver features and improvements in a timely, iterative manner, with clear alignment on priorities, dependencies and delivery cadence.
  • Make difficult trade-off decisions based on value, effort and impact, balancing short-term wins with long-term vision.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams to drive product launches, adoption and growth.
  • Analyse product performance through metrics and KPIs, and use those insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Represent the voice of the client at every stage of product development.
  • Understand risks associated with the products and work with stakeholders to reduce or mitigate them.
  • Ensure product solutions meet Lloyd’s Market regulatory, compliance and operational standards, and maintain awareness of London Market developments relevant to our products, including the market’s current incremental modernisation agenda.
  • Leverage AI tools, including Claude, to enhance product discovery, accelerate user story development, and improve the quality and speed of backlog management. Champion AI-assisted ways of working within the Product Management & Delivery team.
  • Stay actively informed on how AI is reshaping the Lloyd’s and London Market insurance landscape, and translate that awareness into product thinking, identifying opportunities where AI-enabled features can give Buckhill’s clients a competitive edge.
  • Travel to meet clients and partners to better understand their needs and further nurture those relationships as and when needed.
Leading the Client Product Owner team
You will be accountable for the performance, capability and development of the Client Product Owner team.
  • Line manage the Client Product Owner team, including goal setting, regular 1:1s, performance reviews and individual development planning in line with Buckhill’s performance framework.
  • Own capability and capacity planning across the team, including recruitment, onboarding, workload allocation and succession.
  • Set and maintain consistent product standards across the team: how discovery is run, how backlogs are structured, how requirements are written, and how product decisions are recorded and communicated.
  • Actively develop London Market knowledge across the team, drawing on your own market background alongside our structured training pathway, including CII LM1 and LM2.
  • Act as the escalation point for product decisions and for conflicting stakeholder priorities across product teams.
  • Represent the Product Management & Delivery function in leadership forums and contribute to wider organisational and resource planning.
  • Build a culture of accountability, evidence-based decision making and continuous learning within the team.
jobAdDetails.benefits:
• Remote work
  • Sponsored professional learning
  • Fully covered sick leave
  • Child and family support
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Career switch opportunities
  • A healthy work-life balance
  • Permanent full-time contract
  • Working schedule flexibility
  • Multi-role options
  • Leadership opportunities

jobAdDetails.title: Sales Administrator
jobAdDetails.description:
Overview:

As a Sales Administrator at UNiDAYS, you’ll play a vital role in the New Business team’s success. You’ll make an impact by supporting the smooth running of daily operations and new partner launches, managing conferences and hospitality events, and championing data integrity across the team.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
EXPERIENCE: What we need you to have done
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and stay on top of competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A confident communicator who enjoys working with different people and can build positive relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to solving problems and getting things done.
  • Comfortable learning new systems and processes, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and ask questions when needed.
  • An interest in events, partnerships, or commercial teams, but no previous experience is required. We're looking for someone with the right attitude, enthusiasm, and eagerness to learn.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms google sheets/ excel and handling data (previous Salesforce experience is a bonus).
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
RESPONSIBILITIES: What we need you to do
  • Sales Performance & Launch Operations: Support daily new business sales operations by performing post-launch checks, managing asset collections, and monitoring affiliate performance. Ensure data integrity in tracking systems and support the team to onboard new partners and book marketing campaigns.
  • Marketing & Campaign Support: Act as the primary liaison between internal marketing teams and partners. Manage campaign briefings, maintain marketing trackers, coordinate asset/guideline delivery, and facilitate the creative review process for new partner launch campaigns.
  • Event Coordination & Management: End-to-end management of B2B conferences, and new business hospitality events. This includes venue/photographer sourcing, negotiating pricing, managing event portals, handling attendee lists, and overseeing logistics like stand design and merchandise production.
  • Events Optimisation: Deliver proactive event planning, budget tracking, and  performance evaluation to ensure optimisation for future new business events.
  • Administration: Support pipeline hygiene by updating Salesforce and other new business reporting methods (google sheets/excel). Conduct daily tracking and  performance monitoring, in addition to supporting finance and billing operations, related to new partnerships.
